blocking_findings.summary: [P1] Finalize batch eligibility before making the prompt claimable (apps/core/src/application/interactions/pending-interaction-prompt-binding.ts:99): The prompt is bound first, and only afterward are its members updated one-by-one to `eligible: false`.

ASKFLOOR-1-T3c-AC2: CONTEXT + DURABLE PATH. NEW `application/permissions/human-decision-learning.ts` declares `PermissionRememberContext` and exports async `derivePermissionRememberContext(input) → Promise<PermissionRememberContext>` (ruling 3) and `parsePermissionRememberContext(value: unknown) → PermissionRememberContext | null` (complete validation: `eligible` boolean; `lane` in the closed lane set; `laneInput.permissionMode` in the closed mode set and `hostJobId` string or absent; `appId`, `agentFolder`, `canonicalTool` non-empty strings; `personId`/`personLabel` strings or absent; `effectHash` non-empty string; `effectSchemaVersion`, `railVersion` integers; `workspaceRoot` string or absent; `kindVariant` in the closed pair; each candidate a well-formed `HumanDecisionScopeKeyResult`; anything else → `null`); the `requestPermissionApproval` closure in `ipc-interaction-processing.ts` derives the context and awaits `updatePendingInteractionPayload` BEFORE delegating to the durable flow (ruling 3; the helper's `IpcDeps.requestPermissionApproval` signature at `ipc-permission-classifier-decision.ts:68` gains the optional typed second argument, and its two prompt exits pass it); the inline path derives it in `inline-permission-memory.ts` and persists it with the member; `bindPendingPermissionInteractionMessage` finalizes `eligible` from `matchKind` (ruling 3) and its exposed options accept the widened carrier; `claimPermissionInteractionCallback` persists the tapped value verbatim in `claim_mode`; `rememberSettlementForClaim(claim)` is the single accessor every settlement path uses (context + decoded resolution from the same claimed row); the Postgres mapper validates `claimMode` and every rendered option through the codec on read; recovery decodes the persisted code into the identical `{ mode, remember }`; `already_decided` never learns; the control API stays scalar-only (ruling 9). Tests: the context round-trips through the member payload, a batch binding turns it ineligible, and `rememberSettlementForClaim` returns context and resolution by claim and by recovery (unit, `pending-interaction-durability.test.ts`); claim persists a code and the mapper refuses an unknown `claim_mode` or rendered option (Postgres, `worker-coordination.postgres.integration.test.ts`); exact, category-kind and tool-kind candidates in a persisted context equal a fresh derivation including each typed refusal, `kindVariant` selects between the two kind candidates, a place code resolves `no_root`, the encoder returns `null` for a deny with kind or place scope, and a malformed context (each field class) parses to `null` and learns nothing while the scalar current-request result still settles (`human-decision-learning.test.ts`); the control API renders a remember code as its scalar base and rejects a code on its POST (NEW `test/unit/control/session-interaction-approvals.test.ts`).

ASKFLOOR-1-T3c-AC4: WRITE-THEN-APPLY CALLERS. (a) IPC: NEW `runtime/permission-remember-settlement.ts` (the IPC module is at its 865-line ceiling) called from `ipc-interaction-processing.ts` just before `applyPermissionInteractionDecision` (`:269`): decodes the settled mode, reads the member's context, calls `learnRememberedDecision` with a `HumanDecisionMemoryService` over the coordinator's `decisionMemory` port; the application and event sequence (`:269-382`) are byte-identical for remembered and once-only taps. (b) Inline: `inline-permission-memory.ts` gains `inlineRememberSettlement(...)` called from the existing `afterDecision` hook (`inline-agent-loop-tools.ts:483-543`, ≤ 6 changed lines); it never throws into `runDurablePermissionInteraction`. (c) Recovery: `pending-interaction-permission-callback.ts` calls the optional `learn` dependency just before the recovered apply (`:491`); `pending-interaction-durability.ts` threads it; `runtime-store.ts` configures it (ruling 7). Tests: IPC suite (`ipc-interaction-handler.test.ts`) — the context is persisted before the durable flow is delegated to and its lane and effect hash equal the helper's; a crash after the provider claim but before the helper returns still recovers with a context; an eligible remembered Allow persists before application with unchanged events; a remembered No persists and the current call is denied; `ask`, `auto_strict`, group (blank person), batch and scheduled-job prompts persist nothing (one case each); a provider double-delivery is `already_decided` with zero writes; a persisted-eligible context whose `laneInput` re-derives a non-`interactive_auto` lane writes nothing. Inline suite — eligible Allow on a non-scheduled auto run persists once with `personId`/`personLabel` from the run's host identity (label undefined when the run has none); scheduled run persists nothing; port failure leaves the decision applied. Recovery suite — a recovered remember code learns once through the same helper; an unauthorized tapper is rejected before the claim with no write and no application; an authorized code on an ineligible card settles its scalar base once with no write; a crash before learning learns on recovery; a crash after learning ends with one active row through the refresh. Wiring — `test/unit/storage/runtime-store.test.ts` proves the production `learn` dependency reaches the callback path.

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Do not continue when remember-context persistence returns false (apps/core/src/runtime/permission-remember-settlement.ts:43): The boolean result from `persistPermissionRememberPromptContext` is ignored, so the code delegates to the approval flow even when the durable member was not updated.
